difference: KataGo uses rectangular Loc coordinates; GoCube uses [x,y] fixtures and integer action indices.
The PASS action is encoded as point_count in GoCube and as KataGo's pass Loc in the oracle adapter.
KataGo derives rectangular four-neighbor edges from board coordinates; GoCube obtains the same logical edges from Topology.neighbor_indices().
The adapter normalizes both engines to white_minus_black for comparison; rule engines are not changed.
